data.name: Ov_NetDetail
data.value:
These are the addresses of this computer's network adapters, plus https connection URLs built from the service port.
• Whether a client can connect depends on the service listening, network routing and the firewall; copying a URL does not prove it is reachable remotely. • The server TLS certificate is self-signed and contains no IP; clients check the certificate thumbprint recorded at pairing, not the address. • Loopback addresses only work on this computer; link-local IPv6 addresses include this computer's interface number, so their URLs cannot be copied.
